text:
God says:


"It was an urgent matter; I asked myself

what purpose my strangest creatures served:

the dragon, the angel, the unicorn.

I summoned those I believed in,

real, powerful, indisputable:

the baobab, the workhorse, the mountain leaning on the sea.

They held ten conferences

without reaching agreement.

so I have kept

the dragon, the angel, and the unicorn;

but to avoid certain misunderstandings

I thought it wise to make them invisible."

translation.title: God Says:
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the comic theology of usefulness and invisibility.
